en: The postcard image is a black and white nighttime photograph showing a brightly lit Christmas tree standing prominently in a city square, surrounded by market stalls. The background reveals old European style buildings. In the lower part of the card there are two circular insets: one with an antique camera labeled 'Photoapparate,' and another featuring boxed items labeled 'Parfümerien'. The text on the card is in German, advertising the 'Fotozentrale Knauth' located at 'Elbstrasse 4.'
